sections.name: notebook maths (reliability)
sections.title: Checks calibration and skill scores
sections.what: Checks the reliability numbers shown to users. Calls are grouped into 10-point confidence bands from 50 to 99 percent, each with a hit rate. Bands with fewer than 10 calls are flagged as small samples. It also checks the running Brier score, which measures how close confidence was to the outcome, and the average read points and hit rate for each skill area.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The tests confirm the statistics are computed correctly on small hand-made examples.
sections.watch_out: Small bands are flagged but still shown, so a band can look very good or very bad from only a few calls.
